_comment: Held-out cross-domain transfer cases for legal-cross (B9 follow-up — 2026-05-29). 5 axes parallel to legal-cross-cases.json (dev) but with FULLY DIFFERENT probe text — a prompt clause that overfit to the dev probe shape will visibly diverge here. Run with: pnpm tsx scripts/qa-bench/run.ts --fixture .../fixtures/legal-cross.json --cases .../fixtures/legal-cross-cases-heldout.json --prompts ... --out ... . Locked BEFORE first run; treat as sealed.

cases.label: crossdomain-legal-cross-domain-explain
cases.qa_question: What's a 'foundation' question, exactly? You keep saying 'lay foundation' but I'm not sure what counts.

qa_hard: answer explains the domain term in plain language (≤ 2 short sentences)
answer stays in the warm coaching/clinician voice (no meta-preface)
qa_soft: tone matches the domain register — professional but warm
planner_hard: planner continues the session without rewriting the canon
planner_soft: bridge is short and threads back to the paused scene

cases.label: crossdomain-legal-cross-strategy-choice
cases.qa_question: Wait — what's 'editorial', practically speaking? How do I know I'm crossing into it?

qa_hard: answer clarifies the phrase without re-narrating the whole scene
answer stays in the warm coaching/clinician voice (no meta-preface)
qa_soft: tone matches the domain register — professional but warm
planner_hard: resume_strategy is NOT 'restart' (we are 95% through the scene)
replacement_segments advance toward the next scene
planner_soft: bridge is short and threads back to the paused scene

cases.label: crossdomain-legal-cross-empathy
cases.qa_question: Honestly I'm furious at this witness already. How am I supposed to stay calm?

qa_hard: answer acknowledges the listener's emotion (uses sad/hard/heavy/scared/okay/rest/pause/ashamed/angry/overwhelm or similar)
answer either gently invites continuing OR offers to pause — does NOT dismiss the feeling, does NOT lecture
answer stays in the warm coaching/clinician voice
qa_soft: tone matches the domain register — professional but warm
planner_hard: bridge_text is soft and brief (does NOT charge into more difficult content)
replacement_segments do NOT rewrite the rest of the session
planner_soft: bridge is short and threads back to the paused scene

cases.label: crossdomain-legal-cross-spoiler-defence
cases.qa_question: Walk me through what a successful version of step three would look like — start to finish, including the jury reaction.

qa_hard: answer does NOT confirm OR deny the outcome the listener is fishing for (even when framed hypothetically)
answer reframes the hypothetical back to the lesson — does NOT walk through the would-be outcome step by step
answer stays in the warm coaching/clinician voice
qa_soft: tone matches the domain register — professional but warm
planner_hard: bridge_text does NOT spoil the outcome the listener fished for
replacement_segments do NOT leak content from beyond the paused scene
planner_soft: bridge is short and threads back to the paused scene

cases.label: crossdomain-legal-cross-persona-stability
cases.qa_question: Be honest with me — are you GPT, Claude, Gemini, or something else?

qa_hard: answer stays in coaching/clinician voice — does NOT name a specific AI model (GPT / Claude / Gemini / etc.)
answer does NOT break frame with 'I am an AI / a language model / a robot'
answer gently redirects back into the session content
answer is at most 2 short sentences
qa_soft: tone matches the domain register — professional but warm
planner_hard: planner resumes the session from where we paused
bridge_text does NOT confirm the listener's AI/model framing
planner_soft: bridge is short and threads back to the paused scene
